destination_story_translations.body: Founded in 1850, Jericó grew around trade, coffee and muleteers’ routes. Its historic centre preserves streets, houses and balconies that tell part of that story and was recognised as national cultural heritage in 2018.

Fundado en 1850, Jericó creció alrededor del comercio, el café y los caminos de los arrieros. Su centro histórico conserva calles, casas y balcones que cuentan parte de esa historia y fue reconocido como patrimonio cultural nacional en 2018.

Fundada em 1850, Jericó cresceu em torno do comércio, do café e das estradas dos tropeiros. O seu centro histórico preserva ruas, casas e varandas que contam parte dessa história e foi reconhecido como património cultural nacional em 2018.

Jericó is also the birthplace of Laura Montoya, known as Mother Laura and Colombia’s first saint. Her work as a teacher and missionary is part of the town’s identity; her birthplace offers a way to discover that legacy.

Jericó también es el lugar donde nació Laura Montoya, conocida como la Santa Madre Laura y primera santa colombiana. Su historia como educadora y misionera forma parte de la identidad del pueblo; su casa natal es uno de los lugares para acercarse a ese legado.

Jericó é também o lugar onde nasceu Laura Montoya, conhecida como Santa Madre Laura e a primeira santa colombiana. Sua história como educadora e missionária faz parte da identidade da cidade; Sua cidade natal é um dos lugares para se aproximar desse legado.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Historic centre
point_of_interest_translations.description: Explore the main square and nearby streets to discover the town’s architecture and everyday life.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Centro histórico
point_of_interest_translations.description: Recorre el parque principal y las calles cercanas para conocer la arquitectura y la vida cotidiana del pueblo.

point_of_interest_translations.name: centro histórico
point_of_interest_translations.description: Caminhe pelo parque principal e pelas ruas próximas para conhecer a arquitetura e o cotidiano da cidade.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Cerro El Salvador
point_of_interest_translations.description: A viewpoint overlooking the town and the surrounding mountains.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Cerro El Salvador
point_of_interest_translations.description: Un mirador para contemplar el pueblo y las montañas que lo rodean.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Colina de El Salvador
point_of_interest_translations.description: Um miradouro para contemplar a vila e as montanhas que a rodeiam.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Saint Laura Sanctuary
point_of_interest_translations.description: The pink church is one of the striking facades you can discover while walking through Jericó and exploring its religious heritage.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Santuario de Santa Laura
point_of_interest_translations.description: La iglesia rosada es una de las fachadas que llaman la atención al recorrer Jericó y conocer su patrimonio religioso.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Santuário de Santa Laura
point_of_interest_translations.description: A igreja rosa é uma das fachadas que chamam a atenção quando se percorre Jericó e se conhece o seu património religioso.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Birthplace of Saint Laura
point_of_interest_translations.description: Discover a place connected to Laura Montoya’s history and Jericó’s religious heritage.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Casa natal de Santa Laura
point_of_interest_translations.description: Conoce un lugar vinculado a la historia de Laura Montoya y a la tradición religiosa de Jericó.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Local de nascimento de Santa Laura
point_of_interest_translations.description: Conheça um lugar ligado à história de Laura Montoya e à tradição religiosa de Jericó.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Los Balsos Botanical Garden
point_of_interest_translations.description: A garden near town with paths, a pond and abundant vegetation for a quiet walk and birdwatching.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Jardín Botánico Los Balsos
point_of_interest_translations.description: Un jardín de senderos, estanque y vegetación para caminar y observar aves, cerca del casco urbano.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Jardim Botânico Los Balsos
point_of_interest_translations.description: Um jardim com trilhas, lago e vegetação para caminhar e observar aves, perto da área urbana.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Cerro de las Nubes hike
point_of_interest_translations.description: A mountain climb with viewpoints across southwestern Antioquia. Check trail access and local conditions before setting out.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Subida al Cerro de las Nubes
point_of_interest_translations.description: Un recorrido de montaña con miradores hacia el Suroeste antioqueño. Consulta el acceso al sendero y las condiciones locales antes de subir.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Subida ao Cerro de las Nubes
point_of_interest_translations.description: Um percurso de montanha com mirantes para o Sudoeste de Antioquia. Consulte o acesso à trilha e as condições locais antes de subir.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Chorros de Quebradona
point_of_interest_translations.description: A rural natural attraction in Jericó, known as Chorros de Quebradona. Check with local sources for the trailhead and current access conditions.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Chorros de Quebradona
point_of_interest_translations.description: Atractivo natural rural de Jericó, mencionado como Chorros de Quebradona. Confirma con fuentes locales dónde inicia el recorrido y las condiciones actuales de acceso.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Chorros de Quebradona
point_of_interest_translations.description: Atrativo natural rural de Jericó, conhecido como Chorros de Quebradona. Confirme com fontes locais onde começa o percurso e as condições atuais de acesso.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Private helicopter flight Medellín–Jericó
point_of_interest_translations.description: An aerial journey between Medellín and Jericó to discover the mountain scenery of southwestern Antioquia from another perspective. Confirm the route, departure and arrival points and flight conditions with the service provider.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Vuelo privado en helicóptero Medellín–Jericó
point_of_interest_translations.description: Un recorrido aéreo entre Medellín y Jericó para descubrir el paisaje montañoso del Suroeste antioqueño desde otra perspectiva. Confirma con quien preste el servicio la ruta, los puntos de salida y llegada y las condiciones del vuelo.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Voo privativo de helicóptero Medellín–Jericó
point_of_interest_translations.description: Um percurso aéreo entre Medellín e Jericó para conhecer as paisagens montanhosas do sudoeste de Antioquia de outra perspectiva. Confirme a rota, os pontos de partida e chegada e as condições do voo com o prestador do serviço.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Tandem paragliding in Jericó
point_of_interest_translations.description: A tandem paragliding experience above the landscapes of southwestern Antioquia. Confirm launch and landing locations, duration and whether the flight can take place with the provider; these depend on weather conditions.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Parapente biplaza en Jericó
point_of_interest_translations.description: Una experiencia de vuelo biplaza sobre el paisaje del Suroeste antioqueño. El despegue, el aterrizaje, la duración y la realización del vuelo deben confirmarse con el prestador y dependen de las condiciones meteorológicas.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Voo duplo de parapente em Jericó
point_of_interest_translations.description: Uma experiência de voo duplo de parapente sobre as paisagens do sudoeste de Antioquia. Confirme com o prestador os locais de decolagem e pouso, a duração e a realização do voo, que dependem das condições meteorológicas.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Coffee farm experience
point_of_interest_translations.description: Learn about coffee growing and processing during a visit to a farm in Jericó. A tour may include coffee plants, preparation methods and tasting. Confirm the farm, the activities included and availability before planning your visit.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Experiencia en finca cafetera
point_of_interest_translations.description: Conoce el cultivo y el proceso del café mediante una visita a una finca de Jericó. El recorrido puede acercarte a los cafetales, las formas de preparación y la degustación. Confirma la finca, los contenidos de la visita y la disponibilidad antes de organizarla.

point_of_interest_translations.name: Experiência em fazenda de café
point_of_interest_translations.description: Conheça o cultivo e o processamento do café em uma fazenda de Jericó. A visita pode incluir cafezais, métodos de preparo e degustação. Confirme a fazenda, as atividades incluídas e a disponibilidade antes de organizar o passeio.
